_why: 🔴 ONE TABLE, TWO LANGUAGES. `core/src/feeds.rs::word_value_at` and `web/src/RunTab.tsx::words` scan the same dialect and cannot share code — this file is what they share instead. A census in feeds.rs claimed 'a test comparing the two' existed for a day before this file did; it did not, and on 2026-08-28 the two readers were measured disagreeing on every case below marked `wasDivergent`. Add a case here and BOTH readers are tested against it.
_shape: letter/value pairs the scan must produce for the given line, in order. `null` value = the reader must produce a value it cannot use (NaN in both languages) — a NAMED word, never a silently dropped one.

cases.note: whitespace is not significant to grblHAL
a spaced value is one word
grbl's own read_float accepts a leading +

cases.wasDivergent: browser read 1.2 — a confident, plausible depth; the core read NaN and refused
both read 10 and discarded -20; grblHAL answers error:20 and runs no part of the block
browser dropped X entirely, so a block it could not read looked like a block with fewer words

cases.note: a Z inside a comment is not a Z word
( NESTS — a non-counting stripper leaves `c )` standing as code
an unclosed ( swallows the rest of the line and no more
a ; INSIDE a comment does not truncate the line
